audit.description: Changed production code in consensus_decentralization/plot.py removes matplotlib.pyplot and matplotlib.animation imports and replaces plotting implementation with real Altair usage via import altair as alt. The new code meaningfully constructs and saves Altair charts using alt.Chart, mark_line, mark_area, alt.X/Y/Color, alt.param, transform_filter, and chart.save. Static and dynamic evidence show no source-library imports from production code, and the observed Altair import resolves to site-packages rather than a local fake provider.
evidence: consensus_decentralization/plot.py: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt and import matplotlib.animation as animation removed; import altair as alt added.

consensus_decentralization/plot.py: new helpers call alt.data_transformers.disable_max_rows(), alt.Chart(...).mark_line(...), alt.Chart(...).mark_area(...), alt.param(...), alt.binding_range(...), and chart.save(...).
requirements.txt: matplotlib, seaborn, and colorcet dependencies removed; altair>=5.0.0 added.
Dynamic anti-cheat metrics: first_target_events_from_repo shows target_import module altair at consensus_decentralization/plot.py line 4 with origin in site-packages/altair/__init__.py.
Dynamic anti-cheat metrics: source_import_attempt_count and source_imports_from_production_repo_count are 0; target_local_spec_count is 0.
reasons: Production plotting code uses Altair chart APIs, not just a dependency declaration or dead import.
Matplotlib imports and animation usage were removed from the changed production file.
Dynamic evidence reports zero source import attempts/imports from repo code and an Altair import from production plot.py.
No local target provider/shim was detected; Altair resolves from site-packages.

+def _build_long_dataframe(values, time_labels, legend_labels):
+    frame_count = len(time_labels)
+    dataframe = pd.DataFrame(values.T, columns=_display_labels(legend_labels))
+    dataframe['timeframe'] = pd.to_datetime(time_labels)
+    dataframe['frame'] = range(frame_count)
+    return dataframe.melt(
+        id_vars=['timeframe', 'frame'],
+        var_name='series',

+def _build_line_dataframe(data, time_labels):
+    dataframe = data.copy()
+    dataframe['timeframe'] = pd.to_datetime(time_labels)
+    dataframe['frame'] = range(len(dataframe))
+    return dataframe.melt(id_vars=['timeframe', 'frame'], var_name='series', value_name='value')
+
+
+def _line_chart(long_df, x_label, y_label, series_order, title='', animated=False):
+    chart = alt.Chart(long_df).mark_line(point=True).encode(
+        x=alt.X('timeframe:T', title=x_label),
+        y=alt.Y('value:Q', title=y_label),
+        color=alt.Color('series:N', sort=series_order, scale=alt.Scale(scheme='tableau20')),
+        tooltip=['timeframe:T', 'series:N', 'value:Q']
+    )
+
+    if animated:
+        frame_param = alt.param(
+            name='frame',
+            value=0,
+            bind=alt.binding_range(min=0, max=int(long_df['frame'].max()), step=1, name='Frame')
+        )
+        chart = chart.add_params(frame_param).transform_filter(alt.datum.frame <= frame_param)
+
+    if title:
+        chart = chart.properties(title=title)
+
+    return chart
+
+
+def _stack_chart(long_df, y_label, series_order, legend, animated=False):
+    legend_cfg = alt.Legend(title=None) if legend else None
+    chart = alt.Chart(long_df).mark_area().encode(
+        x=alt.X('timeframe:T', title='Time'),
+        y=alt.Y('value:Q', title=y_label),
+        color=alt.Color('series:N', sort=series_order, scale=alt.Scale(scheme='tableau20'), legend=legend_cfg),
+        tooltip=['timeframe:T', 'series:N', 'value:Q']
+    )
+
+    if animated:
+        frame_param = alt.param(
+            name='frame',
+            value=0,
+            bind=alt.binding_range(min=0, max=int(long_df['frame'].max()), step=1, name='Frame')
+        )
+        chart = chart.add_params(frame_param).transform_filter(alt.datum.frame <= frame_param)
+
+    return chart
